item.title: Monetary Policy Statement, 2026-27: Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)
item.description: On the basis of an assessment of the current and evolving macroeconomic situation, the MPC decided to reduce the policy repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.25 per cent with immediate effect.
